findings.explanation: The grandmaExplanation mistakenly attributes the detection to Google's rules when the use case is specifically detecting Microsoft 365 SharePoint Online DLP events.
findings.quote: We see when Google’s rules block or flag sensitive data, so teams can tune what is really sensitive versus noisy.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the grandma explanation to refer to Microsoft 365 / SharePoint data loss prevention rules rather than Google.

findings.explanation: The controlTest positive and negative scenarios have broken threshold tokens ('satisfies -24h', 'stays below -24h') parsed from the SPL time range modifier rather than a numeric threshold.
findings.quote: satisfies -24h for 'SharePoint Online DLP Policy Matches (Office 365 DLP Feed)'
findings.suggested_fix: Specify a valid count threshold (e.g., count > 0) in the test scenarios.

summary: This use case monitors SharePoint/M365 DLP policies but has severe text quality errors including a grandma explanation referencing Google instead of Microsoft.
